text:
maria: PTAL — I pushed an update that addresses the review comments from earlier. Short summary:
- removed the redundant allocator lock and clarified ownership in comments
- added unit test to cover rotation edge case (test_kv_rotate_race)
- broke out the retry/backoff helper into utils/retry.go with a small docstring
- squashed the fixups into one commit to keep history tidy
CI link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1745556666

alex: looked at the diff, the lock removal makes sense. left one inline stylistic nit (rename func -> clearer name). not blocking. :thumbsup:

sam: good catch on the race. left a note about adding a small sleep in the test to make it less flaky; optional but helps on the flaky Windows runner. also, CI failed on windows earlier — can you kick it after the push?

priya: quick suggestion — add a one-line comment in retry.go about why we picked exponential backoff vs constant. otherwise LGTM from my side.

maria: thanks all — addressed Alex's rename and added the comment in retry.go. kept the test sleep but made it conditional on runtime.GOOS == "windows" to avoid slowing linux runs. force-pushed: https://git.internal.redwood/p/runtime/branch/1745556666

ci-bot: Build queued. linux: running, windows: queued.

alex: re-run locally, tests pass. approving now.

alex: APPROVE :white_check_mark:

sam: looks stable on my local VM too. leaving approve.

priya: approve from me as well.

ci-bot: linux build passed (all tests). windows build flaked on test_timeout.go; rerun scheduled.

maria: thanks everyone — merging once the flakey windows run clears or CI marks it non-blocking. planning to schedule canary for Friday AM PST. will follow up with a short rollback plan in #eng-oncall.

alex: sounds good — if windows keeps flaking we can merge with the flaky test marked flaky and follow up with a separate fix. not a blocker for the release.

maria: noted, will keep you posted. PTAL if you want to double-check the final merge commit.
